name: What factors influence the cost of adding a second story to a home?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of adding a second story to a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a second-story addition is influenced by several factors, including the existing home's structural capacity, the new square footage added, the complexity of the design, and the chosen finishes. Integrating new HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems, as well as exterior finish matching, also plays a significant role. AKN Design Group provides upfront estimates during our detailed design phase, ensuring you understand the investment involved in enhancing your home's functionality and beauty. We focus on value engineering where appropriate, without compromising on craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include structural capacity, square footage, design complexity, and finishes. We provide upfront estimates and integrate essential systems while maintaining craftsmanship.
